definition_zh: 谐音的；元音韵的；音似的
definition_en: having or showing assonance; having similar vowel sounds
core_image: 几行诗里元音像同一色系的灯次第点亮
scene: 她把两行诗并排写在黑板上，圈出彼此呼应的元音字母。The assonant vowels in those lines give the verse its music.
sceneCN: 这里 assonant 是「谐音的」（第 1 个义项：元音相似的）；句意为这些诗行里谐和的元音赋予诗句音乐感。

derivatives.zh: 同根名词，义为「元音韵；谐音」
由同根加动词后缀构成，义为「呈谐音」

senses.title: Having similar vowel sounds
senses.definition: sharing similar vowel sounds, especially in nearby words or lines
senses.definitionCN: 共享相似元音，尤指邻近词语或诗行中
senses.example: The assonant chime of those syllables lingers.
senses.exampleCN: 那些音节谐和的鸣响久久萦绕。
senses.why: As the adjective of assonance, it describes what sounds toward what else.
senses.whyCN: 作为 assonance 的形容词，它描绘「朝彼此发声」的性质。

senses.title: Agreeing in sound generally
senses.example: The two names are assonant enough to confuse listeners.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个名字音似到足以让听者混淆。
senses.why: Sounding toward becomes sounding alike in any context.
senses.whyCN: 「向对方发声」在任何语境中都引申为「听来相像」。

intro.en: Assonant comes from Latin assonans, the present participle of assonare, to sound toward.
intro.cn: assonant 源自拉丁语 assonans，即 assonare（向…发声）的现在分词。

items.cn: 拉丁语 sonare 意为发声。

items.en: Assonans described something sounding in answer.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 assonans 形容应声之物。

items.en: Old French carried assonant into verse terminology.
items.cn: 古法语将 assonant 引入诗律术语。
英语与 assonance 一同借入 assonant。

note.en: Assonant is the describing form of the echo that assonance names.
note.cn: assonant 是 assonance 所指回响的描述形式。

entries.definition: sounding together; also a speech sound

entries.definitionCN: 刺耳的；不协和的（同根反前缀）

normalIntro.en: Add -ant to assonance: something that is doing the vowel-echoing.
normalIntro.cn: 在 assonance 后加 -ant：表示「正在进行元音呼应的」。

normal.en: sonare means to sound, as in sonic.
only vowels are compared in this word.
poets chain assonant vowels for music.
normal.cn: 诗人串联谐和元音制造乐感。

abstract.en: Picture twin lanterns glowing the same shade.
abstract.cn: 想象一对同色发光的双灯笼。

abstract.en: Hear two strings tuned to one pitch.
abstract.cn: 听两根琴弦调成同一音高。

abstract.en: Feel vowel letters as matching keys on a ring.
abstract.cn: 体会元音字母如同一串相配的钥匙。

examples.en: The assonant pattern repeats the long a sound.
examples.cn: 这一谐音模式重复长 a 音。

examples.en: Medieval chants often used assonant endings.
examples.cn: 中世纪圣咏常用元音韵结尾。

examples.en: Her assonant phrasing made the poem hum.
examples.cn: 她谐音的措辞让诗篇嗡嗡作响。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额搜能特」——额搜出能特别应和的音，元音相似即 assonant。

root: 拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ sonare（发声）→ assonans（应声的）→ 英语 assonant（谐音的）。

sensesIntro.en: The describing form of vowel-echo covers both poetic craft and plain likeness.
sensesIntro.cn: 元音呼应的描述形式既指诗艺，也指单纯的音似。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: vowels echoing the same tone across words
core.cn: 核心意象：元音在词语间应和同一音调

branches.en: the son- root doing the echoing
a craft beside rhyme and meter

intro.en: Assonant adds the -ant describing suffix to the sounding root.
intro.cn: assonant 在发声词根上加了描述性后缀 -ant。

latinIntro.en: Latin assonans, sounding in answer, is the direct source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 assonans（应声的）是直接来源。
